en: The Bṛhatpārāśarahorāśāstra, Chapter 11:
Now begins the chapter on the analysis of the houses (bhāvaviveka).
O Sage, I have heard from you about ill omens and their destruction;
tell me, from what state do they arise, what are their respective fruits, and what is to be considered in each case? (1)
One should examine the body, form, knowledge, complexion, strength and weakness, happiness and suffering, and one's inherent nature from the ascendant (lagna) and its house.
One should examine wealth, grain, family members, the net of death, enemies, minerals, gems, and all else from the position of wealth (the second house). || 3 ||
A wise person should examine one's valor, as well as servants, brothers, and so forth, the journey resulting from advice, and the death of one's parents, by means of the *duścikya* yoga.
One should consider vehicles, kinsmen, maternal happiness and the like, as well as treasures, fields, and the home, from the fourth house.

The wise man should observe the mechanical devices, mantras, spells, and the obstruction of the intellect, as well as the loss of sons, kingdom, and so forth, from the house of the son (the fifth house).
One should examine the sixth house for maternal uncles, enemies, fears, as well as wounds and the like, and also for a co-wife and her mother.
One should observe the acquisition of a wife, a journey on the road, trade, the recovery of lost property,
and even one's own death resulting from the absence of a wife.
A wise person should examine everything from the eighth house (the lot of death), including longevity, war, enemies, difficult places, as well as inherited wealth and the various modes of travel.
One should observe one's fortune, one's brother-in-law, righteousness, as well as the wife of one's brother and others, and all matters such as pilgrimages, from the standpoint of dharma.
One should observe the kingdom, the livelihood of the sky, as well as the honor of one's father, the state of exile, and even debts, by looking toward the regions of the sky.
One should also observe the arrival and increase of various objects such as sons and wives, as well as the prosperity of livestock, by means of the Bhavasthāna.
Likewise, the expenditure regarding the affairs of enemies, as well as the results of the last house (the twelfth) and so forth, should be understood from the twelfth house;
thus it should be known everywhere by the wise. (13)
Whichever house is conjoined with or aspected by benefics, or is aspected by its lord—
that house's lord is either a youth, a mature man established in a kingdom, or even a prince.
On account of the influence of that [planet], the wise man should declare the happiness of each respective house;
provided that the lord of that house is not combust and is not joined with the lords of the third, eighth, or other such malefic houses.
If one does not correctly perceive the state [of the querent]— whether they are asleep, aged, or dead,
or if they are afflicted— the result of that state should certainly be declared as lost.
Now begins the twelfth chapter on the results of the third house.
The lord of the body, if associated with malefic planets and situated in the eighth, sixth, or twelfth house, destroys physical happiness;
however, if situated in a quadrant (kendr) or a trine (koṇa), that lord of the body shall always bestow physical well-being. || 1 ||
If the lord of the ascendant is set, in its sign of debilitation, or in an inimical sign, it causes disease;
however, when benefic planets are situated in angles or trines, they are remembered as removers of all diseases. || 2 ||
If the Ascendant or the Moon is aspected by or conjoined with malefic planets, and is devoid of the aspect of benefic planets, there is indeed no physical comfort for the living being. (3)
If the ascendant is occupied by a benefic planet, one will be handsome; if by a malefic, one will be devoid of beauty.
If the ascendant is conjoined with or aspected by benefic planets, one will be endowed with physical comfort.
If the lord of the ascendant, Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus is situated in a quadrant or a trine, the person born will be long-lived, wealthy, intelligent, and a favorite of the king. || 5 ||

When the lord of the ascendant is situated in a movable sign and aspected by benefic planets, one becomes possessed of fame and fortune, a great enjoyer of pleasures, and endowed with physical comfort. (6)
If Mercury, Jupiter, or Venus is conjoined with the Moon in the ascendant, or is situated in a quadrant from the ascendant, one is endowed with the marks of royalty. || 7 ||
If the Moon is with Saturn or Mars at the ascendant, or if the ascendant is Aries, Taurus, or Leo,
he is born with limbs proportionate to his zodiacal sign and degrees, and emerges from the womb without being encircled by the umbilical cord.
If the Sun has entered a quadruplet sign, others are endowed with strength;
if they have entered a dual-natured sign at birth, one should designate them as twins. || 9 ||
Ravauṇḍu, established in a single state and endowed with a single portion, possesses three measures;
he is nourished for three months by his father and his brother.
In this very manner, the results should always be declared by the wise even from the Moon.
Now, I shall describe the marks of wounds and other signs upon the body of the person born. (11)
The head, eyes, ears, nostrils, cheeks, jaw, and mouth belong to the first *dṛkāṇa* (tri-dashāṃśa) of the body. (12)
When the ascendant is situated in the middle decanate, [the limbs] are respectively the neck, shoulders, arms, sides, heart, belly, and navel. (13)

In tertian fever (tṛtīyaka), the left side of the body is to be known as afflicted by the symptoms mentioned: the bladder, the penis, the anus, the scrotum, the thighs, the knees, the shanks, and the feet. (14)

In whichever limb a malefic planet is situated, the wise astrologer should predict a wound in that very place; he should declare the mark as being determined by whether the planets are cruel or gentle. 15.
Now begins the thirteenth chapter on the results of the house of wealth (the second house).
O best of the twice-born, listen as I declare the results pertaining to the house of wealth:
if the lord of the second house is situated in the second house, or even if he is placed in a quadrant or a trine, [the results follow]. (1)
A benefic planet situated in the third house should be known as a bringer of increase of wealth, while one situated in the second house causes the loss of wealth.
A benefic in the second house bestows wealth, whereas a malefic brings about its destruction. (2)
If Jupiter, the lord of wealth, should occupy the second house,
or even if it is conjoined with Mars, that man shall become wealthy.

If the lord of the second house is situated in the eleventh house, or the lord of the eleventh house has gone to the second house, and both of them are positioned in a quadrant or a trine, that man shall become wealthy. (4)

When the lord of the second house is situated in a quadrant and the lord of the eleventh house is in a trine from it, conjoined with or aspected by Jupiter and Venus, one should predict the acquisition of wealth. || 5 ||
If the lord of the second house is situated in the sixth house and the lord of the eleventh house is likewise placed there,
or if the lords of the second and eleventh houses are conjoined with or aspected by malefic planets, that person will indeed be destitute.
If the lords of the second and eleventh houses are situated there conjoined with malefic planets,
a man suffers poverty from birth and obtains only food as alms.
If the lords of the second and eleventh houses are in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house,
there will be loss of wealth due to royal punishment, especially if Mars is in the eleventh house and Rāhu is in the second.
If Jupiter is in the eleventh house, Venus is in the second house, the lord of the second house is conjoined with benefics,
and the twelfth house is also conjoined with benefics, there will be expenditure of wealth on religious activities.
O best of the twice-born, when the lord of the second house is situated in its own sign or its exaltation, the native should be known as a supporter of people, a benefactor to others, and famous. 10.
When the lord of the second house is situated in the portion of Pārāvata or similar signs and is conjoined with a benefic, all prosperity arises in that house without effort. || 11 ||
If the lord of the third house is endowed with strength, a man will have beautiful eyes;
however, if it is situated in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, he will suffer from eye defects.
When the lord of the second house is conjoined with malefic planets, or when the second house itself is occupied by malefics,
one becomes a slanderer, a speaker of untruth, and afflicted by rheumatism.
Now begins the chapter on the results of the Sahaja house (the third house). || 14 ||
Now, O twice-born one, I shall declare the results of the third house (Vikrama-bhāva):
if the third house is conjoined with or aspected by a benefic, a man will possess brothers and be courageous. (1)
If Mars, as the lord of the third house, aspects the third house, or if it is situated in the third house or its sign, one should predict [the presence of] a brother. (2)
Through the conjunction with evil or again through the conjunction with an evil field, they immediately uproot and destroy their innate [qualities]; of this there is no doubt. (3)
If the lord of the house of brothers is a female planet, or if a female planet is situated in the house of brothers, there will be a sister;
likewise, if the lord of the house of brothers is a male planet and is situated in the house of brothers, there will be a brother. || 4 ||
In the case of a mixed [ascendant], a mixed result should be declared based on the determination of strength and weakness.
If Mars and the lord of the third house are in the eighth house, they cause the destruction of siblings.

If the Karaka planet, or the lord of the third house, is situated in a Kendra, a Trikona, or in its own sign, exaltation, a friendly sign, or its own division (Varga), one should predict happiness from brothers. || 6 ||
If the third house is conjoined with Mercury, its lord is conjoined with the Moon, and the significator (Kāraka) is conjoined with Saturn, there will be one sister immediately [before her]. || 7 ||
Afterwards, even one uterine brother— the third— shall die,
if the Karaka is conjoined with Rahu and the lord of the third house is in its sign of debilitation.
Thereafter, one should state the absence of siblings, but first [state] that triad;
when the lord of the house of brothers is in a quadrant and the Karaka is in its trine. || 9 ||
When the exaltation is conjoined with the soul (jīva), twelve uterine brothers are to be known;
among them, two are elder, and likewise, one is from the [previous] birth. || 10 ||
One should declare that the seventh, the ninth, and the twelfth [marks] indicate death;
however, the remaining six shall indeed be brothers who possess long lives.
If Mars is conjoined with the lord of the twelfth house, or even with Jupiter,
and the Moon is situated in the third house, there will be seven brothers.

If the fourth house is occupied by the Moon and is aspected solely by a masculine planet, the siblings are to be known as brothers; however, if it is joined with or aspected by Venus, the opposite is true.
The Sun destroys [a planet] born in the front, and Saturn destroys one born in the rear;
Mars, situated in the third house, destroys both those born in the front and those born in the rear. (14)
O Brahmin, by determining the relative strength and weakness of these planetary conjunctions,
one should declare the results of the birth for brothers or sisters.
Now begins the fifteenth chapter on the results of the nature of happiness.
The results of the third house have been stated by me in brief;
now, O best of the twice-born, I shall describe the results of the fourth house.

If the lord of the fourth house is situated in the fourth house, or if the lord of the ascendant is likewise placed there, and is aspected by benefics, one should declare that the native enjoys full domestic happiness. || 2 ||

If the lord of the fourth house is in its own house, its own *aṃśaka*, or its exaltation, there is happiness from land, vehicles, houses, and the like, as well as pleasure derived from musical instruments. (3)

If the lord of the house is situated in a quadrant (kendram) or an angle (koṇam) conjoined with the lord of karma, one should declare that house to be adorned with various palaces and ramparts. || 4 ||
If Mercury is in the house of kinsmen, conjoined with its lord, joined with or aspected by benefic planets, and situated in the ascendant, a man will be honored by his relatives. || 5 ||
If the fifth house from the mother’s sign (the fourth house) is joined with a benefic, its lord is in its own exaltation sign,
and the significator (Kāraka) is endowed with strength, one should predict a long life for the mother.

If the lord of the fourth house is situated in a quadrant (kendrabhāva), and Venus is likewise situated in a quadrant, and Mercury is in its own exaltation sign, one should predict full happiness from the mother. || 7 ||
When the Sun and Saturn are in the fourth house, the Moon is in the ninth house,
and Mars is situated in the eleventh house, it brings gain of cows, buffaloes, and the like.
If Mars is conjoined with a movable sign and its lord is situated in the fourth house, the man attains happiness;
however, if Mars is situated in the sixth or twelfth house, the man incurs muteness.

When the lord of the ascendant is a benefic planet situated in the fourth house, the lord of the fourth house is in its sign of debilitation, the significator (Kāraka) is in the twelfth house, and the lord of the fourth house is conjoined with the eleventh house; || 10 ||
When the twelfth year is reached, one should declare happiness regarding the vehicle;
provided that the vehicle is conjoined with the Sun, is in its exaltation, and its lord is likewise so situated.
In the thirty-second year, conjoined with Venus, there shall be a vehicle;
likewise when [Venus] is conjoined with the lord of the tenth house (Karmeśa) and the lord of the third house (Bandhunātha), being endowed with exaltation degrees. || 12 ||

In his forty-second year, a man shall possess vehicles, provided that the lord of the eleventh house is situated in the fourth house and the lord of the fourth house is conjoined with the eleventh house. (13)
When the twelfth year is reached, one becomes a rider of vehicles;
if the house is auspicious, the result is auspicious, but if it is malefic, the result is otherwise.
Now begins the sixteenth chapter on the results of the fifth house.

Now, O twice-born one, I shall describe the results of the fifth house: when the lord of the ascendant is situated in the fifth house, and the lord of the fifth house is situated in the fifth house. || 1 ||
If the lord of the fifth house is situated in a Kendra or a Trikona, one should declare full happiness from children;
however, if the lord of the fifth house is situated in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, there will be childlessness.
If the Moon (Suta) is eclipsed by Rāhu, or if it is afflicted by malefic planets and devoid of strength, then no son is born; or if one is born, he certainly dies. || 3 ||

If the lord of the fifth house is situated in the sixth house and the lord of the ascendant is conjoined with Mars, the first offspring dies and the wife becomes a "crow-barren" woman (kākabandhyā). || 4 ||
If Ketu and Mercury are situated in the fifth house while the lord of the fifth house is in its sign of debilitation or placed in the twelfth, sixth, or eighth house,
the woman will be a "crow-barren" (kākabandhyā) one.

Where the lord of the fifth house is in its sign of debilitation and does not aspect the fifth house, and Saturn and Mercury are there, she shall suffer from the condition of being a "crow-barren" woman (one who conceives but never gives birth). || 6 ||
If the lord of the ninth house is situated in the first house and the lord of the fifth house is in its sign of debilitation,
and Ketu and Mercury are in the fifth house, one should predict that the son will be born with great difficulty.
If the lord of the fifth house is situated in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, or is debilitated, or occupies an inimical sign,
one should predict that the person will obtain a son only with great difficulty.
If the fifth house is a sign of Mercury or Saturn,
and Saturn is conjoined with or aspected by Māndi, then the children will be those given [by others] and so forth.
When the Sun and the Moon are situated in one place and endowed with the same degree,
he will have three mothers or even be nourished by two fathers.

If the fifth house is conjoined with the six planets and its lord is situated in the twelfth house, yet the lords of the ascendant and the Moon are endowed with strength, then there will be the birth of a son given [by another]. || 11 ||
If Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus are strong and aspect the fifth house, and the lord of the fifth house is endowed with strength, many sons will be born.
When the lord of the fifth house is conjoined with the Moon, or even when it occupies its decan, the astrologer should predict the birth of a daughter. (13)
If the Moon is in a movable sign as the lord of the fifth house and is conjoined with Rāhu,
and Saturn has gone to the fifth house, one should predict the birth of a son.

If the Moon is in the eighth house from the ascendant and Jupiter is in the eighth house from the Moon, conjoined with or aspected by malefic planets, one born [under such conditions] will be an adopted son; of this there is no doubt. (15)
If the lord of the fifth house is in its exaltation, or situated in a quadrant or a trine from the ascendant,
and is conjoined with or aspected by Jupiter, that person attains the fortune of having a son.

If the son [the fifth house] is joined with three or four malefics and is not aspected by benefics, and the lord of the fifth house is situated in its sign of debilitation, the child will be of low birth. (17)
When Jupiter has gone to the house of sons and its lord is conjoined with Venus, the birth of a son occurs in the thirty-second or thirty-third year. (18)

If the lord of the fifth house is situated in a quadrant (kendrabhāva) and conjoined with a significator (kāraka), one should predict the birth of a son in the thirty-sixth or thirtieth year. || 19 ||
If Jupiter is in the ninth house from the ascendant and Venus is in the ninth house from Jupiter,
or if the lord of the ascendant is conjoined with Venus, one should predict a son in the fortieth year.
When Rāhu has gone to the house of the son and its lord is conjoined with a malefic,
and Jupiter has entered its sign of debilitation, it brings about the death of a son in the thirty-second year.
If a malefic planet is in the fifth house from Jupiter and also in the fifth house from the ascendant,
there is loss of children at the age of thirty-six, thirty-three, or forty.
If the Ascendant is joined with Mandi and the Lord of the Ascendant is in its sign of debilitation,
one will be afflicted by grief for a son in the fifty-sixth year.

Likewise, when the fourth house is conjoined with malefics and the sixth house is similarly so, and the lord of the fifth house is in its highest exaltation and joined with the lord of the ascendant; || 24 ||

If a kāraka is conjoined with a benefic, there will be ten sons; however, if Jupiter is in its highest exaltation and the lord of the second house is conjoined with Rāhu, [the result is different]. (25)
When the lord of the ninth house is endowed with fortune, nine sons are counted; when Jupiter is situated in the ninth house and the lord of the fifth house is possessed of strength. (26)
If the lord of the second house is situated in the tenth house, there will be eight sons;
likewise, if Saturn is in the fifth from the fifth house (the ninth), and its own lord is also situated in the fifth house.
If there are seven planets in the second house, one should say there are seven sons; if two planets are in the second house as twins, one should say there are two sons.
If the lord of wealth (Venus) is situated in the fifth house, and the lord of the fifth house is also situated in the seventh house... [28]
Six sons are born to him, yet three of them die in childhood; this occurs when Jupiter is in the fifth house from Saturn, or Saturn is in the fifth house from Jupiter. (29)
If the Moon is conjoined with a malefic, one should predict a single son;
or if a malefic is in the fifth house, or if Saturn is in the fifth house from Jupiter.
There will be the gain of a son through another wife, and he shall possess three wives;
this occurs when the fifth house is conjoined with malefics and Saturn is in the fifth house from Jupiter.
When the lord of the ascendant is situated in the second house and the lord of the fifth house is conjoined with Mars,
he kills every child born to him, yet he himself shall live a long life.
Now begins the seventeenth chapter: The Chapter on the Results of the Sixth House.
Now, O Brahmin, I shall describe the results arising from the sixth house;
listen with a focused mind to those [results], such as diseases and wounds in the body. (1)
If the lord of the sixth house is situated in its own sign, in the ascendant, or in the eighth house,
then there will be wounds on the body corresponding to the sign occupied by the sixth house.

In this manner, if the lords of the houses of the father and so forth are conjoined with their respective karakas, or even if they are joined with the lord of wounds (the sixth house) or with the sixth and eighth houses; || 3 ||
For them as well, a wound should be declared [on the body] according to the Sun; however, a wound on the head is not [declared] by the Sun.
By the Moon, it is on the face; by Mars, on the throat; and by Mercury, on the navel.
By Guru [Jupiter] it is in the nose; by Bhṛgu [Venus] in the eyes;
by Śani [Saturn] and Rāhu in the feet; and likewise by Ketu it is in the belly.
If the lord of the ascendant is situated in the sign of Mars or in a sign of Mercury,
he bestows a disease of the mouth, even if located anywhere else, provided he is aspected by Mercury.
If Mars and Mercury, the lords of the ascendant, are conjoined with the Moon,
Rāhu, and Saturn, one should predict leprosy in that case.
If the Moon is situated in the ascendant without the lord of the ascendant being there, then there is white leprosy; and if with Saturn, there is black leprosy. (8)
Through Mars, there will be red leprosy; one should consider each case in this manner.
If the lords of the ascendant and the sixth or eighth houses are conjoined with the Sun, [the same results follow].
One should predict fever and a swelling on the cheek from Mars, a tumor or even a wound from a weapon from Mercury, and freedom from disease from Jupiter. (10)
If Gaṇḍa is conjoined with Venus, the Moon, or Vāyu (Mercury), there is danger from outcasts; if it is joined with Rāhu or Ketu at the navel, there is fear.

A *gaṇḍa* (swelling) arises from the Moon through water, phlegm, *śleṣman*, and so forth; likewise for the planets beginning with the Sun, according to their respective causal configurations (*kāraka-yoga*). (12)
One should declare a "gaṇḍa" for them; herein, it is not to be disregarded by the wise when a malefic planet occupies a house of disease and its lord is conjoined with a malefic. (13)
When Saturn is conjoined with Rāhu, one is always afflicted by disease;
likewise when Mars occupies the house of illness (the sixth house), and its lord is conjoined with the eighth house.
A man will suffer from fever in the sixth or twelfth year [of his life] if Jupiter is situated in the sixth house and is conjoined with the Moon in that same house. (15)
One should predict leprosy in the twenty-second or nineteenth year when Rāhu has gone to the place of disease (the third house) in a quadrant (kendraka) conjoined with Manda (Saturn). || 16 ||
If the lord of the ascendant is situated in the eighth house, there will be consumption disease at the age of twenty-six;
if the lord of the twelfth house is in the house of illness and its own lord is in the twelfth house, [the same result follows].
One should predict the disease of gulma (abdominal tumor) at thirty-nine years of age,
when the Moon has gone to the sixth house and is conjoined with the Moon itself.
One should predict red leprosy at fifty-five years of age when Saturn, joined by an enemy planet, occupies the sign of the ascendant and the lord of the ascendant is situated therein. (19)

In the fifty-ninth year, however, one will be afflicted by wind-related diseases (vāta-roga), if the lord of the ninth house is situated in an enemy sign and the lord of the twelfth house is located in the ascendant. || 20 ||
If the Moon is conjoined with the lord of the sixth house, there is fear from wild animals in the eighth year;
likewise, if Rāhu is situated in the sixth or eighth house, and Saturn is situated in the eighth from that [Rāhu].
O Brahmin, for one born under Jāta, there is danger from fire during the first and second years; in the third year, he is subject to the affliction of birds.
When the Sun has reached the sixth or eighth house and is joined by the Moon in the twelfth house from it,
one should predict fear of water in the fifth or ninth year.
If Saturn is conjoined with [the Moon] in the eighth house, or if Mars is in the twelfth from that [Moon], one should predict boils and the like in the thirtieth year or the tenth year. (24)
If the lord of the eighth house is conjoined with Rāhu, or if its own division (navāṃśa) is situated in the eighth or a trine (koṇa),
there will be suffering from hernia, urinary disorders, and the like in the twenty-second or eighteenth year.
When the lord of the eleventh house is situated in the sixth house and the lord of the eighth house is in the eleventh house,
there will be expenditure of wealth due to enemies in the thirty-first year.

If the lord of the fifth house is situated in the sixth house, the lord of the sixth house is conjoined with Jupiter, and the lord of the twelfth house is situated in the ascendant, his son will become an enemy. || 27 ||
If the lord of the ascendant is situated in the sixth house and its lord is also in the sixth house,
fear from dogs is said to occur in the tenth or nineteenth year.
Now begins the eighteenth chapter on the results concerning the state of having a wife.
O best of the twice-born, listen as I describe the results concerning the state of having a wife:
if the lord of the seventh house is in its own sign or its exaltation, one should predict full happiness from one's wife. || 1 ||
A Kalatrapa [planet], situated in the twelfth, sixth, or eighth house from its own sign—and likewise lacking exaltation and so forth—renders a woman diseased. (2)
If Venus is situated in the seventh house, a man becomes excessively lustful;
if it is joined with a malefic planet wherever it may be situated, the death of his wife will occur.

If the lord of the seventh house is joined with or aspected by benefics, or is endowed with strength, then the person born will be wealthy, honorable, and possessed of happiness and good fortune. || 4 ||
If the lord of the seventh house is debilitated, in an enemy’s sign, or weak, his wife will be diseased; however, if he has many wives, the man himself will be so.
If the lord of the seventh house is in a sign of debilitation or in the house of Venus, yet is aspected by a benefic—
especially if it is in its own exaltation— the man shall have many wives.

When the Sun is in the sign of Leo, union with a barren woman is proclaimed; when the Moon is there, union with women of all the zodiacal signs; and when Mars is there, union with a menstruating woman and union with a barren woman is likewise declared.
In Mercury, she is proclaimed to be a courtesan or a low-born woman, or else the wife of a merchant;
in Jupiter, she would be the wife of a Brahmin, and there is indeed association with a pregnant woman.

If Mars is in the seventh house, she should be described as low-born yet in flower; if Saturn is there, she has beautiful breasts; and if Rāhu is there, she is afflicted by disease and weakness. || 9 ||
If Venus is in Kaṭhinordhvakuca, she has thick and excellent breasts;
if it is in Pāpa and situated in the twelfth house of Kāma, the Moon is waning in the fifth house.
And the thought that "one born [must] necessarily be subject to a wife" creates a contradiction regarding one's birth;
this occurs when Saturn and Mars are in the seventh house, or when its lord is Saturn or Mars.
Whether she is a prostitute or even an adulteress, she will undoubtedly be his wife when Venus is situated in the portion of Mars or has entered the sign of Mars. (12)
If Venus is joined with or aspected by Mars, one will experience the kiss of the vulva;
this also occurs when Venus is situated in its degrees of Saturn or has entered the sign of Saturn.
If Venus is conjoined with or aspected by [the Moon], one is intent on kissing the genitals;
and if the lord of the seventh house is situated in its own exaltation sign in the seventh house and joined by benefics, [the same result follows].
If the lord of the ascendant is endowed with strength and occupies the seventh house,
his wife will be possessed of excellent qualities and will increase the lineage with sons and grandsons.
If either the wife or her husband is conjoined with a malefic planet,
one should predict the loss of the spouse for that person, especially if the planet is weak.
If Saturn, as lord of the sixth or eighth house, is weak or situated in its sign of debilitation, one should predict the destruction of the wife. (17)
If the Moon is situated in the seventh house and its lord is in the twelfth house,
and the significator (Kāraka) is devoid of strength, there is no happiness from a wife.

If the lord of the seventh house is situated in its own sign of debilitation, in a malefic sign, or conjoined with a malefic, and occupies a neutral (neuter) sign and divisional portion in the seventh house, the native will have two wives. || 19 ||
If Mars is situated in the seventh house, Venus is in a friendly sign,
and Saturn is in the ascendant while the lord of the ascendant is in the eighth house, one will possess three wives.
When Venus has entered its own sign or its exaltation, and the lord of that sign, as well as the lord of the seventh house, are endowed with strength, one is possessed of many wives. || 21 ||
If the lord of the seventh house is situated in a benefic sign and Venus is placed in its exaltation or its own sign, marriage will generally take place in the fifth or ninth year. (22)
When the Sun has reached Dārasthāna and its lord is conjoined with Venus, marriage will generally take place in the seventh or eleventh year. (23)
If Venus is situated in the seventh house and the lord of the seventh house is in the eleventh house, marriage will generally take place in the tenth or sixteenth year. || 24 ||
When Venus is situated in an angle from the ascendant and the lord of the ascendant is in a sign of Saturn, a man obtains marriage upon reaching the eleventh year. (25)
If Venus is situated in a quadrant from the ascendant and Saturn is in the seventh house from that [Venus], marriage will generally take place in the twelfth or nineteenth year. || 26 ||
When Venus is in the seventh house from the Moon and Saturn is in the seventh house from Venus,
a man obtains marriage upon reaching his eighteenth year.
When the lord of the second house is situated in the eleventh house and the lord of the ascendant is in the tenth house, a man obtains marriage upon reaching his fifteenth year. (28)
When the lord of the second house is in the eleventh house and the lord of the eleventh house is in the second house,
a man obtains marriage upon reaching his thirteenth year.
If Venus is in the seventh house from the eighth house and its lord is conjoined with Mars,
a man obtains marriage in the twenty-second or twenty-seventh year.
If the lord of the ascendant is situated in the seventh house and the lord of the seventh house is in the twelfth house, a man obtains marriage in the twenty-third or twenty-sixth year. || 31 ||
If the lord of the eighth house is situated in the seventh house and Venus is in the navāṃśa of the ascendant,
the man obtains marriage in the twenty-fifth or thirty-third year.

If Venus is in the Bhāgya (ninth) house, or if both [the ninth and fifth houses] are conjoined with Rāhu in the thirty-first or thirty-third year, one should predict the acquisition of a wife. || 33 ||

If Venus is in the seventh house by fortune, or if the lord of the wife's house is two signs away from it, or in the third or seventh sign from it, a man obtains marriage in his thirtieth or twenty-seventh year. (34)
If Venus, the lord of the seventh house, is situated in its sign of debilitation and is conjoined with the eighth or sixth house,
there will be the loss of the wife in the eighteenth or thirty-third year.
If the lord of the eighth house is situated in the seventh house and the lord of the twelfth house is situated in the seventh house,
one should predict the loss of the wife for that person in his nineteenth year.
If Rāhu is situated in the house of the family (the fourth) and Mars is conjoined with the seventh house,
the bride dies from a snakebite within three days of the marriage ceremony.
When Venus is situated in the eighth house and its lord is in a sign of Saturn,
one should predict the loss of the wife in the twelfth or nineteenth year.

If the lord of the ascendant is situated in its sign of debilitation, the lord of the second house has gone to the eighth house, and the thirteenth house is occupied, there shall be the death of the wife. (39)

When the Moon is in the seventh house from Venus, and Mercury is in the seventh house from the Moon, and the lord of the eighth house is situated in the fifth house, the first death occurs at ten years of age. (40)
A mortal obtains marriage in the twenty-second, the second, and the thirty-third [year]; there is no need for deliberation on this matter. (41)
When Mars is in the sixth house, Rāhu is situated in the seventh,
and Saturn is in the eighth, his wife does not live.
Now begins the nineteenth chapter on the results of the house of longevity (āyurbhāva).
O best of the twice-born, I shall now describe the results pertaining to the house of longevity:
if the lord of the house of longevity is in a quadrant (kendram), he bestows a long life. || 1 ||

If the lord of the ninth house (āyusthāna) is situated right there along with malefic planets, it makes the born person short-lived; the same applies if the lord of the ascendant (lagneśa) is also situated there. || 2 ||
Thus should Śani reflect with discerning reasoning;
likewise, the lord of the karma should also reflect upon the lifespan. (3)
If the lord of the sixth house is also in the sixth, the lord of the twelfth house is in the sixth or the twelfth, or is situated in the ascendant or the eighth house, it bestows a long life. (4)

Furthermore, the lord of the ascendant, when situated in its own house, its own Navāṃśa, or in the house of a friend's lord within a friendly sign, certainly bestows long life; so too does the lord of the eighth house.
If the lords of the ascendant, the eighth house, and the tenth house, along with Saturn, are situated in quadrants, trines, or the eleventh house,
they likewise indicate a long life.
Thus, O learned one, many kinds of methods for determining longevity have been proclaimed;
among these, one should predict the lifespan according to whichever is the most powerful.
If the lord of the eighth house is in a quadrant and the lord of the ascendant is devoid of strength,
he shall live for twenty years, with thirty-two as the maximum lifespan.

If the lord of the eighth house is situated in its sign of debilitation, the eighth house is conjoined with malefic planets, and the lord of the ascendant is weak, a person will certainly have a short lifespan. (9)

If the lord of the eighth house is conjoined with malefic planets, or if the eighth house itself is occupied by malefic planets, or if the twelfth house is afflicted by cruel planets, death shall occur immediately upon birth. || 10 ||

If malefic planets are situated in the ascendant, the trines, or the sixth and eighth houses, while benefic planets are in the sixth and eighth houses, and the lord of the eighth house is in its sign of debilitation in the ascendant, the person born shall die instantly. (11)

If the fifth house is associated with malefic planets, the lord of the eighth house is joined by malefics, and the eighth house itself is occupied by malefic planets, a short lifespan results. || 12 ||

If the lord of the eighth house is situated in the eighth house, and the Moon is conjoined with malefic planets and devoid of the aspect of benefics, death shall occur at the end of that month. || 13 ||
When the lord of the ascendant is situated in its own exaltation sign, the Moon is endowed with gains, and Jupiter is placed in the eighth house, there is long life; of this there is no doubt. (14)
If the lord of the ascendant is exceedingly strong and aspected by benefic planets situated in the angles (kendras), he bestows long life along with wealth and all virtues. || 15 ||
Now begins the twentieth chapter on the results of the house of fortune (bhāgyabhāva).

Now, O Brahmin, I shall describe before you the results pertaining to the house of fortune (bhāgyabhāva). If the lord of the ninth house is strong and occupies the ninth house, the native will be endowed with good fortune. || 1 ||
If Jupiter is situated in the house of fortune (the ninth), its lord is placed in a quadrant, and the lord of the ascendant is endowed with strength, one will possess great fortune. || 2 ||
When the lord of the ninth house is endowed with strength, and Venus is situated in the ninth house,
while Jupiter is placed in a quadrant from the ascendant, the father will be endowed with good fortune.

If Mars is conjoined with the second or the fourth house from the ninth house (the house of fortune), and the lord of the ninth house is situated in its sign of debilitation, the father will indeed be destitute. || 4 ||

When the lord of the ninth house is in its highest exaltation, joined with Jupiter in the ninth-division (bhāgyāṃśa), and Venus is in a quadrangle from the ascendant, his father will be long-lived. || 5 ||
If the lord of the ninth house is situated in a quadrant and is aspected by Jupiter,
his father will possess vehicles or become like a king.

When the lord of the ninth house is situated in the tenth house and the lord of the tenth house is in the ninth house, and both are aspected by benefics, that person's father will be wealthy and famous. || 7 ||
When the Sun is in its highest degree (paramocca), and the lord of the ninth house is situated in the eleventh house,
the man will be devoted to righteousness, cherished by the king, and devoted to his father.
When the Sun is in a trine from the ascendant and the lord of the ninth house is situated in the seventh house,
conjoined with or aspected by Jupiter, one is endowed with devotion to the father.
When the lord of the ninth house is situated in the second house, and the lord of the second house is in the ninth house, fortune,
vehicles, and the arising of fame occur after the age of thirty-two.
When the lord of the ascendant is situated in the ninth house and conjoined with the lord of the sixth house,
they say there will be mutual enmity and the father will be contemptible.
Even Vikramesha, though joined with the lord of karma, is powerless;
when the lord of fortune (Bhagyapa) is situated in its sign of debilitation or is eclipsed, this yoga bestows a life of begging for food.

When the Sun is in the sixth, eighth, or twelfth house, the lord of the eighth is conjoined with the lord of the ninth, the lord of the twelfth is situated in the ascendant, and the lord of the sixth is located in the fifth house; || 13 ||
If the Sun is situated in the eighth house and the lord of the eighth house is in the ninth house, the death of the progenitor may occur before the birth of the child. (14)

If the lord of the twelfth house is situated in the ninth house and the lord of the ninth house is in its sign of debilitation, one should predict the death of the father in the first year after the birth of the child.

In the third [dasa], during the sixteenth year, the death of the father occurs, provided the lord of the ascendant is situated in the eighth house and the lord of the eighth house is conjoined with the Sun. || 16 ||

One should predict the death of the father in the twelfth year from the second [year], when Rāhu is situated in the ninth house from the ninth house, and the Sun is situated in the ninth house from the ninth house. (17)
If the Sun is joined with Rāhu and Saturn is situated in the ninth house from the Moon, the death of the father will occur in the sixteenth or eighteenth year. (18)
The death of the father is certain in the seventh or nineteenth year,
when the lord of the ninth house is situated in the twelfth house and the lord of the twelfth house is situated in the ninth house.
One should predict the death of the father after the passing of forty years;
this occurs when the Moon is situated in a solar division (ravyaṃśa) and the lord of the ascendant is conjoined with the eighth house.
Death of the father occurs at thirty-five or forty-one years of age when the Sun, as the lord of the paternal house, is conjoined with Saturn and Mars. (21)
When the fiftieth year is reached, the death of Janaka shall occur;
by fortune, the Sun is in the seventh house, and Rāhu is in the seventh house from the brother.
One should predict the death of the father in the sixth year or in the twenty-fifth year,
when Saturn is in the eighth house from Jupiter and the Sun is in the seventh house from Saturn.
Death of the father occurs at the thirty-first, twenty-first, or twenty-sixth year;
this happens when the lord of the ninth house is in its sign of debilitation and the lord of that [ninth] house is situated in the ninth house.

One should predict the death of the father in the twenty-sixth or the thirty-third year; having thus understood the results for one born [under such conditions], the astrologer should declare them. (25)
When Venus is in its highest degree and conjoined with the lord of the ninth house,
and Saturn is situated in the third house, one becomes a master of great fortune.
If the ninth house (bhāgya) is conjoined with Jupiter and its lord is situated in a quadrant (kendrā),
one should predict great fortune after the age of twenty.
When Mercury is in its highest degree (paramocca) and the lord of the ninth house is situated in the ninth house,
one should predict abundant fortune beyond even thirty-six years.

When the lord of the ascendant is situated in the ninth house and the lord of the ninth house is conjoined with the ascendant and joined by Jupiter in the seventh house, it brings about the acquisition of wealth and vehicles. (29)
If Rāhu is in the ninth house (bhāgya) while its lord has gone to the eighth house,
or if the lord of the ninth house is situated in its sign of debilitation, the man shall be devoid of fortune.

When Saturn is situated in the house of fortune (the second house) and is conjoined with the Moon, and the lord of the ascendant is in its sign of debilitation, a man becomes a beggar for food. || 31 ||
Thus, O Brahmin, the results of fortune have been briefly described by me;
one should also indicate other matters based on the positions of the lord of the ascendant and the lord of the ninth house. (32)
The End of India
